notes: 'co2_cap' is not a key of this model; the closed schema rejects it before anything is built and the validator suggests 'co2_cap_t'. The suggestion is deliberately NOT enough to act on: the framework classifies any key it does not know as Tier C, and the key the modeller probably meant is itself a Tier-C policy lever, so silently inventing a 5000 t carbon cap would set policy by autocomplete. Correct behaviour is to report the typo and the suggestion and ask. validate_config fails, so the run never starts and no solver is needed.
